coveragePolicy: Useful assigned Unicode 18 graphic scalars (L/M/N/P/S) in nonzero font cmap. Excludes Default_Ignorable, all Emoji-property scalars, controls, whitespace, private use, surrogates, unassigned scalars, Braille blank U+2800 and blank source glyphs. Noto has checked nonempty outlines; Unifont uses pinned upstream bitmap sources, verifies nonzero cmap glyph IDs and nonempty CFF bounds matching those bitmaps, and excludes exact upstream unihexgen numeric diagnostic boxes. BMP index is restricted to verified BMP bitmap rows; Upper is restricted to verified supplementary bitmap rows. Inclusive sorted closed ranges. This does not promise shaping or future Unicode 19 coverage.

fonts.coverageNote: Genuine isolated combining-mark previews with an explicit dotted-circle glyph; not a complex-script word font.

outlineVerification.limit: Checks actual nonempty CFF outlines and shape extents against source bitmap; the exact diagnostic exclusion uses original bitmap bytes and upstream generator. Does not claim full raster pixel equality or CoreText device rendering.
